metadata.description: Personal collection of agent skills: small, reusable bundles of instructions for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: coding-python
plugins.description: Practical Python project setup, modern uv/ruff/ty/pytest workflows, PEP 723 scripts, and careful migration from legacy Python tooling.

plugins.name: brainstorming
plugins.description: Structured approach to brainstorming and design. Guides users through clarifying questions, exploring 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, and validating a design incrementally before any code is written.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Structured implementation planning, interactive annotation review via Plannotator (with a local fallback), and plan execution with an adaptive review cascade sized to the plan.
